institucional.title: Company

history.p1: At From Patagonia, our essence is the Argentine Sea. We are a family-owned, long-established company dedicated to the harvesting, processing and export of fish and seafood, with decades of experience, integrating the entire value chain: from fishing in our cold, crystal-clear waters to the global logistics that ensure the product reaches the international market in absolutely fresh condition.
history.title: Our History
history.p2: We operate with our own fleet and process at our plants in Mar del Plata and Trelew under the highest sanitary standards, and our brand and industry are synonymous with full traceability throughout the production chain. We export the richness of our coasts to the world, with the seriousness and commitment that the most demanding markets require.
history.subtitle: The essence of the Argentine Sea
history.p3: Argentine companies widely known in the global market entrust the responsibility of their production to us, because we have extensive experience in this!
